text: bwin is one of Entain plc's sports betting brands: the group's full-year 2025 results announcement describes Entain plc as a FTSE100 company (LSE: ENT) and lists bwin among the sports brands the Group owns.

source.name: Entain plc, 2025 Full Year Results (company news release)
source.quote: The Group owns a comprehensive portfolio of established brands; Sports brands include BetCity, bwin, Coral, Crystalbet, Eurobet, Ladbrokes, Neds, Sportingbet, Sports Interaction, STS and SuperSport
